rules.rule: KHR_xmp_json_ld structure: declared in extensionsUsed, every packet has @context, every reference is in range (the Khronos validator 2.0.0-dev.3.10 does not check this extension)
every Metadata tree returns X3D -> glTF -> X3D on the same host type and DEF, in document order, value for value
Metadata node count is unchanged (no node dropped, none invented)
every IFC GlobalId survives once per element, is queryable in the glTF JSON-LD (loom:ifcGlobalId), and its host Shape keeps the same triangle count
every CIDOC-CRM class reference survives and is typed in JSON-LD (@type crm:E..)
glTF asset packet carries PROV-O: prov:wasDerivedFrom = sha256 of the source X3D, prov:wasGeneratedBy = the converter
